hello: Hey, what's happening? (Karachi street slang, between friends)

greet: Hey yaar, how is it going?
Morning! How was the traffic on Shahrah-e-Faisal?
Hello ji, all well at home?
reply: Fine yaar, just a long week.
sunny: It is scorching today, stay in the shade.
Clear skies, perfect for Sea View this evening.
The sea breeze is finally blowing.
Great day for chai at a dhaba.
rain: Rain in Karachi, the whole city stops.
Roads are flooded near Saddar, take another way.
Carry an umbrella, it is coming down hard.
busy: Running late for office, talk later!
Stuck at Teen Talwar, call you back.
Got a meeting in Clifton, see you!
Bit busy today, let us chat tomorrow.
My Careem is here, have to go!

reply: Allah ka shukar hai, aap sunao?
Bas yaar, guzaara ho raha hai.
sunny: Aaj to bohat garmi hai yaar.
Dhoop bohat tez hai, pani saath rakho.
Shaam ko samandar ki hawa chalegi, phir mazay.
rain: Barish ho rahi hai, sarkon pe pani bhar jayega.
Aaj barish mein traffic jam hoga.
Chhatri le lo, barish tez hai.
busy: Yaar abhi jaldi mein hoon, baad mein baat karte hain.
Office ke liye late ho gaya, chalta hoon!
Bus nikal rahi hai, phir milte hain!
Abhi kaam bohat hai, call karta hoon.

touts: Aa jao, aa jao, khali hai!
Peechay ho jao bhai, jagah banao!
small_talk: Sea View on a Sunday evening, the whole city is there.
Burns Road nihari for breakfast, nothing beats it.
Shahrah-e-Faisal was jammed all the way to Nursery.
One proper rain and half of Saddar floods.
The Green Line is quick, I was in Numaish in no time.
When the sea breeze stops, you know a heatwave is coming.
Dinner at Do Darya tonight? The view is worth it.
Tariq Road is packed before Eid, park far away.
